title: Taiwanese American Association Baltimore 巴爾地摩 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association Baltimore (巴爾地摩 台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations across the United States. The chapter is listed under the TAA’s East Northern (美東北) regional grouping and serves the Greater Baltimore and Columbia area of Maryland, with its presence centered in Ellicott City, Maryland.
